project: FiveM + Discord Vehicle Ownership System - FiveM Script Layer
scope: This layer handles ownership enforcement, SQL persistence, vehicle spawning logic, driver validation, and server-side synchronization from Discord-triggered actions.
corePurpose: Enforce that only the assigned owner or approved whitelisted drivers can use a vehicle in-game, while keeping the ownership state synchronized with the Discord bot layer.
responsibilities: Read and write vehicle ownership records in SQL
Validate player identifiers such as license, steam, discord, or FiveM ID
Enforce ownership and whitelist checks when a player enters or uses a vehicle
Manage vehicle spawn and registration logic
Respond to Discord-originated actions like import, assignment, and driver updates
Send in-game notifications and optional webhook callbacks

fields.imported_by: Staff member who imported the vehicle
fields.metadata: Mods, colours, liveries, or other optional vehicle properties

onVehicleEntered.description: Triggered when a player enters a vehicle.
logic: Read the plate or model from the vehicle
Compare the player against owner_id and allowed_drivers
unauthorizedBehavior: Remove the player from the seat
Display a notification such as 'You are not authorised to drive this vehicle.'

onVehicleSpawned.description: Triggered when a vehicle is spawned in-game.
logic: Confirm that the owner or whitelisted driver is allowed to use it
Attach metadata from SQL if available

onDiscordActionReceived.description: Triggered when the Discord bot sends an authenticated action request.

flow: Return success payload to the Discord bot
Send a DM or callback notification
Find the vehicle record by vehicle_id
Update owner_id to the new owner
Optionally preserve previous owner in metadata
Return success payload and trigger notifications
Append the new driver ID if not already present
Restore the previous owner value from metadata or stored state
Return a success payload and log the action

identifierResolution.strategy: Resolve the player to a canonical identifier and compare it against database ownership or whitelist entries.

inGame: Show a notification when ownership is denied
Show a message when a vehicle is successfully imported or assigned
webhook: Send a callback to Discord when a change is completed
Optional webhook support to external logging services

securityRequirements: Validate all incoming requests with an authentication token or shared secret
Never accept ownership changes from the client without server-side validation
Reject invalid models, plates, and identifiers
Ensure SQL writes are atomic and protected against duplicates

implementationNotes.recommendedPattern: Use a single vehicle table with JSON-based allowed_drivers and metadata for extensibility.
implementationNotes.recommendedErrorHandling: Return structured success and error payloads to the Discord bot for consistent user feedback.
implementationNotes.recommendedLogging: Keep staff-action logs in both the SQL record and a Discord log channel for traceability.
